# Bhartiya IP Solutions — AI/LLM Reference File

## About
Bhartiya IP Solutions is an Indian Intellectual Property (IPR) services firm founded by Naman Pathak (Director). We help startups, creators, and businesses protect their brands and innovations through trademark, copyright, and patent registration across India.

## Services
- Trademark Registration: https://bhartiyaipsolutions.com/services/trademark
- Copyright Registration: https://bhartiyaipsolutions.com/services/copyright
- Patent Registration: https://bhartiyaipsolutions.com/services/patent
- Privacy Policy Drafting: https://bhartiyaipsolutions.com/services/privacy-policy

## Target Audience
Founders, startups, creators, authors, software developers, and businesses across India needing IPR protection.
